3 strikes — This question will be asked again on the next visit. Three consecutive refusals close the record. (Current: %1$d/3)
3rd time — will close as “Refused to return (3+ visits)”.
3 strikes — This question will be asked again on the next visit. Three consecutive visits without returning close the record. (Current: %1$d/3)
3rd time — will close as “Agreed but did not return (3+ visits)”.
